text:
morgan (Finance): Heads up 1: overnight job flagged a ~25% spike in Dedicated GPU spend for us-west-2; large chunk shows as UNASSIGNED in the cost UI. https://billing.internal/redwood/costs?range=24h

cost-alert-bot: :warning: Spending anomaly detected: pool 'dedicated-trial' +24.7% vs baseline. Notifying #finance #eng-platform

sam (FinOps): Quick skim of billing export shows many instances from project trial-zen-004 missing team/cost_center labels. Ballpark impact: ~$13,200 for the 10h window.

ira (Platform): That onboarding path for managed trials shipped a change last night to spin ephemeral Dedicated VMs. We missed passing billing metadata in the ephemeral branch. Raising PR now to default labels.

morgan (Finance): Can FinOps backfill labels so Finance can re-run attribution? Sales may need the numbers to decide billing vs absorption.

sam (FinOps): Backfill plan: 1) enumerate instance IDs from billing export 2) add labels via gcloud 3) re-run ingestion/backfill. Example (dry-run):
```
bq query --nouse_legacy_sql 'SELECT resource.labels.instance_id FROM `billing_export.gcp_resource_usage` WHERE project_id="trial-zen-004" AND usage_start_time > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 12 HOUR)'
for id in $(cat ids.txt); do gcloud compute instances add-labels $id --labels=team=zen,cost_center=trial-zen-004 --project=trial-zen-004 --zone=us-west2-a --quiet; done
```
I need Sales or the customer to confirm we can tag their resources for bookkeeping if they're in their project.

tess (Sales): I'll ping the customer for written ok to tag resources for internal billing attribution. If they approve, post the exact instance list and I'll attach consent to the ticket.

ira (Platform): PR: https://git.internal/onboarding/pull/899 to default billing labels for ephemeral path. Also added short-term monitor 'unlabeled-dedicated-launch' -> #finance + oncall.

cost-alert-bot: Deploy succeeded: onboarding-service label-fix v1.4.2 at 04:05 UTC

sam (FinOps): Once Sales posts approval I'll run the dry-run in staging then apply labels and trigger backfill. Leaving thread open until reconciliation complete. :white_check_mark:
